note: What a server sends to name the units a chain missile will strike in turn. The header names the missile. Where the client already holds the missile, the missile takes the list; otherwise the list waits for the caster's next chain missile.

fields.name: count
fields.note: How many of the slots are used, 0 to 32. A client does not check it.

fields.name: targets

items.name: target
items.note: A unit, in the order struck.

fields.note: Always 32 slots; those past count are unread.
